snippet.title: Spaceport Architect | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Spaceport Architect on Steam! 

Spaceport Architect is a 2D Sci-fi Airport Business Tycoon where you build, manage and expand a spaceport on a recently colonized planet, import cargo to grow the colony population and take care of the resulting passenger traffic to pay the bills.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5075590/Spaceport_Architect?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=page_announce
Discord: https://discord.gg/csdCZ2e3nZ
Sign up for playtesting at: https://djentsoft.com

The game is inspired by SimAirport/AirportCEO and is #MadeWithGodot and C#.

Short version

- Import cargo to grow the planet population
- Build airport-like passenger terminals
- Export goods for profit
- Unlock larger ships as you expand

Longer version

Apart from the sci-fi setting, the game primarily differs from SimAirport/AirportCEO in that it has freight management as a required part of the game loop.

You need to import cargo in order to grow the planet colony population, which directly affects how many passenger contracts you get, how full each flight is and whether they are cancelled or not. Cargo may contain contraband, so you need proper customs checks to avoid reputation penalties. Keep the planet colony happy and you can get lucrative export contracts.

Ships may need repair services, which you can charge for. Charge too much and only extremely damaged ships will request it. I will also add a refuling system, where fuel has to be imported from off-world and stored properly.

There are time-sensitive emergency contracts and one-off special offers, such as passing ship captains urgently wanting to sell their cargo cheap (contraband risk!) or others wanting to rent storage space for a time.

In addition to the planet colony and passing "Free Captains", you have several "spacelines" (e.g. airlines) to unlock, negotiate and build reputations with, each with their own ship classes and requirements. You accept contracts and schedule flights on your landing pads. You can also create and lease shops to your contacts.

Currently working on a proper baggage system, with transparent transport tubes for bags and hover carts used by staff.

PS: If someone tries to pirate the game, they will end up losing all of their ships to... piracy. :)

Current (adjustable) plan

- Playtest start before 2027
- Demo spring 2027
- Release fall 2027

In short, the game puts a new spin on classic base building, city building, management and tycoon games.
